title: Protocol for Polar Metabolomics of Urinary Samples from Cattle
author: Lieven Van Meulebroek
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ngmdbu6

steps.title: Add Internal Standard and Buffer
steps.instruction: Add Propylthiouracil-d5 internal standard and Phosphate buffer containing 1% DL-dithiothreitol to the urinary samples.

steps.title: Extract with Ethyl Acetate
steps.instruction: Perform extraction using ethyl acetate and collect the supernatants in a separate recipient.

steps.title: Evaporate and Reconstitute Sample
steps.instruction: Dry the sample and dissolve the resulting residue in a specific solvent mixture.

substeps.instruction: Evaporate under a gentle stream of nitrogen until dry.
Dissolve the residue in ultra pure water (0.1% formic acid)/methanol (0.1% formic acid) (90/10, v/v).
